column1: # Ports of the world, with 5-degree coordinates.
# Source: Mike's RPG Center reference tables for the 1990 Koei title. Game
# mechanics and factual tables are not copyrightable; no prose or art is
# reused, and this game ships under its own name.
# economy '-' means the port does not trade and serves only as a landfall.
# One source row, Ruwen, is written '5S E35'; read as S5 E35.
# capital 'yes' means the port has a shipyard. Every economy has exactly one,
# except the Mediterranean, which has two because it is twice the size of any
# other and Lisbon is where the player starts. A yard sells only the classes
# its own economy builds; see SPECS in game/src/ship.rs.
